operating_objective.section_title: Operating objective and AI-session displacement test
operating_objective.cutover_test: Can Joe or Dell now complete and understand this routine without opening Claude Code or Codex?
operating_objective.adoption_rule: A routine is not adopted until Joe or Dell can complete and understand it without a heavy Claude Code or Codex session and the old session-driven ritual has an explicit retirement or cutover path.
operating_objective.council_criterion: The Wednesday council must reject a slice that cannot trace the objective and baseline through requirements, screens, canonical data/actions, tests, post-launch comparison, and cutover.

tenant_readiness_and_workflow_governance.launch_scope: One private CARR tenant with Joe and Dell only; tenant-ready safety does not authorize a public SaaS launch.
tenant_readiness_and_workflow_governance.tenant_context: The server derives authoritative tenant context from the authenticated audience, session, membership, and route binding; client or agent supplied tenant identifiers never grant or widen access.
tenant_readiness_and_workflow_governance.cross_tenant_rule: Every tenant-scoped read, write, event, evidence reference, job, and automation must fail closed when the authenticated tenant differs, including fixtures that use otherwise-valid foreign record IDs.
tenant_readiness_and_workflow_governance.workflow_promotion: Promotion is explicit, attributed, reviewable, and gated by named evidence, immutable version, accountable owner, observation window, failure criteria and handling, rollback plan, adoption result, and cutover plan; in-flight work pins its workflow version and retirement preserves audit history and a rollback or replacement path.
tenant_readiness_and_workflow_governance.bounded_trial_rule: A workflow trial must be possible in at most five business days, and may be shorter, using the governed thin primitives, with no new source of truth, destructive migration, parallel writer, or generic workflow engine.

maintenance_budget.measurement_rule: Measure actual human hours; do not invent a baseline or hide toil in agent or vendor cost.
maintenance_budget.exception_rule: Attribute material new scope, vendor or platform incidents, security events, and other approved exceptions separately from normal internal maintenance.
maintenance_budget.toil_trigger: More than five normal internal maintenance hours in each of two consecutive months creates prioritized toil-reduction work.
maintenance_budget.mature_claim_gate: The low-toil mature claim requires three complete consecutive normal months at three to five hours with required release, audit, security, backup, restore, and SLO evidence intact and exception time separately attributed.

ownership_and_commercial_exclusions: Joe retains platform ownership, intellectual property, and control.
A corporation may license owner-controlled seats only as a customer.
No public signup, self-service tenant creation, public SaaS, customer platform control, ownership transfer, or launch-scope expansion is authorized.
No generic workflow engine, plugin marketplace, customer scripting, or customer-authored executable workflow is authorized in the current program.
The amendment does not change the approved delivery timing or cost bands.
tenant_readiness_and_workflow_governance.construction_gate: These are Phase 0 contracts and fixtures only; production construction remains blocked until Joe approves the Wednesday council output.

sponsor_agent_personal_brain_identity_bo.defect: The current standing-context read path defaults personal scope from the runtime actor slug, so a Joe-sponsored Codex session can report 0 codex-personal while the Joe-personal generated render contains 30 active rules.

immutable_dimensions.organization_tenant_id: Server-derived organization boundary for records, events, search, files, calls, memory, queues, integrations, audit, and offline material.
immutable_dimensions.sponsoring_human_id_or_partner_id: Verified Joe or Dell identity that selects the permitted personal brain; it never replaces runtime attribution or grants a capability by itself.
immutable_dimensions.agent_principal_id_or_runtime_principal: Codex, Claude, or another authenticated runtime that remains the action actor in audit and capability evaluation.
immutable_dimensions.session_capability_profile: Server-derived, typed, plan-bound, environment- and resource-scoped authority; sponsor, model, browser, tool, or job input cannot widen it.
immutable_dimensions.personal_brain_scope: Exactly joe-personal, dell-personal, or task-scoped-unsponsored, with a server-resolved version and count.

resolution_contract.joe_sponsored: A Joe-sponsored Codex or Claude session loads the current shared set plus Joe-personal, while actions remain attributed to the runtime agent and audit also records Joe as sponsor.
resolution_contract.dell_sponsored: A Dell-sponsored Codex or Claude session loads the current shared set plus Dell-personal, while actions remain attributed to the runtime agent and audit also records Dell as sponsor.
resolution_contract.unsponsored_background: An unattended or unsponsored agent receives only task-scoped rules, has no human sponsor, cannot claim a human personal brain, and cannot use humanOnly capabilities.
resolution_contract.cross_brain: Joe-personal and Dell-personal never cross-load; a requested cross-brain read is denied before rule bodies are projected.
resolution_contract.failure_semantics: Missing, ambiguous, inconsistent, stale, or unavailable personal scope is an explicit failure or Unknown, never a misleading successful zero.
resolution_contract.parity: Connector/store and generated fallback resolve the same partner brain, version, rule set, and counts; a mismatch is visible drift, not silent fallback success.
resolution_contract.non_escalation: Personal rules may guide presentation and partner preferences but cannot select or change tenant, grant or widen capabilities, silently promote themselves, or alter runtime attribution.
resolution_contract.audit: Audit records tenant, runtime agent, sponsoring human when present, personal-brain scope/version/count, and capability profile without exposing personal rule bodies.

source_evidence.original_live_standing_context: Before repair, Joe's Codex session returned 143 shared and 0 codex-personal.
source_evidence.verified_live_standing_context: After deployment, and on the current fresh read, Joe-sponsored Codex returns 144 shared and 30 Joe-personal with organization tenant carr-internal, sponsoring human joe, runtime and agent principal codex, personal scope joe-personal, and humanOnly authority false.
source_evidence.live_cross_brain_spoof: A caller-supplied partner=dell request was refused as partner_not_selectable before any shared or personal rule arrays were returned.
source_evidence.loop_319: closed done at version 2 after live verification

required_machine_tests: Joe plus Codex returns the current shared count plus 30 Joe-personal rules.
Dell plus Codex returns the current shared count plus the current Dell-personal count.
Cross-brain personal reads deny before bodies are returned.
Runtime agent attribution and verified human sponsor both survive audit.
An unattended agent cannot impersonate a human sponsor or invoke humanOnly verbs.
Missing or ambiguous sponsor or personal scope returns explicit failure or Unknown.
Connector/store output and generated render match partner brain, version, and counts.
Personal rules cannot alter tenant or capability.
Audit carries tenant, agent, sponsor, personal-brain scope/version/count, and capability profile without rule bodies.
